title: Start OpenVPN client manually for troubleshooting
summary: Run the OpenVPN client directly from the terminal to see detailed logs. This is useful for debugging connection issues when the service fails silently.
prerequisites: You have a valid client configuration file.

steps.explain: Start the OpenVPN client with your configuration file. Replace <CONFIG_PATH> with the full path to your client config (e.g., /etc/openvpn/client/client.conf).

placeholders.name: CONFIG_PATH
placeholders.description: Path to the OpenVPN client configuration file
